title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
summary: Itaú is implementing its AI First strategy through the conversational interface ia.i and the IARA governance platform, applying generative AI to both customers and employees in Brazil's highly regulated banking sector.
highlights: Itaú uses ia.i, a conversational interface, for generative AI
IARA governance platform supports AI deployment
AI First strategy targets both customers and employees
Operates in one of Brazil's most regulated sectors
